Try Grok @Bot

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Elon Musk megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Katie Miller (@KatieMiller); megjelent: 2026-10-24T13:54:45+00:00; link: https://x.com/KatieMiller/status/2113992593465860319; média: videó, 79 másodperc]
Stuart Varney: What is this Grok @Bot? You use it. 

Phil Rosen: I am using it.

@Varneyco: Who puts it out? What does it do?

Rosen: This is @elonmusk’s frontier lab. I will share personally, I was on Claude for the last year or so, and I would use Claude, ChatGPT, and a little bit of Muse in the last few weeks. Since I started to use Grok Bot this month, I have essentially cut all my other AI tools.

Varney: What's so good about it?

@philrosenn: It's essentially your own staff of AI agents. You can have a chief of staff agent managing your other AI agents, which, again, I get it, sounds a little ridiculous, and I tell my friends and my parents this and they don't understand, and I have to walk them through it on a Zoom call. I use Grok Bot for a lot of content creation now. I use it for some fact-checking stuff, some editing, research. I use it for helping me with my calendar.
